task: You are now playing a fast paced episode of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First thing I need you to do is to venture east. After that, retrieve the type I key from the floor of the cookery. If you can get your hands on the type I key, unlock the type I gate with the type I key. After that, open the type I gate. After that, make an effort to go to the north. Once you accomplish that, recover the key from the desk. After that, make absolutely sure that the portal is unlocked. And then, doublecheck that the portal is wide open. And then, travel west. Then, go north. After that, go east. With that accomplished, recover the peanut from the floor of the chamber. Got that? Good!
